column1: # Haiku 3 (2026-10-11): larger teams on dst. Same settings as haiku2-dst (Haiku 5.5 xhigh, $0.25 per agent, run to budget).
# 2 teams of 16, 2 teams of 8, and 6 more independents (e11-e16) so best-of-16 can draw on haiku2-dst-indep-e1..e10 too. Max $13.50.
